requirements_summary: Workload: low-latency chat for classroom copilot (median response < 800ms ideally).
Throughput: small — 2000-5000 tokens/day during pilot, potential to scale to 50k tokens/day in 6mo.
Cost sensitivity: high — want clear per-token estimates and easy levers (batching, model variants).
Models: open to curated open models; preference for cost-effective 7B/13B variants. Fallback to higher quality only if accuracy drops.
Routing/fallback: simple—primary hosted model, fallback to smaller model if latency spikes. Need guidance on quality tradeoffs.
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs, retention controls. No on-prem/air-gapped for MVP.
Moderation: automated moderation for student inputs + teacher override UI; need confidence metrics and false-positive tuning.
Integration: REST SDK + JS widget for embedding copilot in LMS. Wants example code and minimal front-end latency.
POC success metrics: moderation accuracy > 95% on flagged harmful content; teacher satisfaction score >= 4/5; cost <$2k/mo.
